newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Educor buys PAG Placements for 108 mln rand.
newsitem.headline: Educor buys PAG Placements for 108 mln rand.

text.p: Education Investment Corp Ltd said on Monday it had acquired the business of PAG Placements, a unit of PAG Ltd, in a deal worth 107.8 million rand.
The purchase will be funded by the issue of 24.77 million Educor shares, placed with institutions at 435 cents each.
PAG Placements, established in 1975, is a leading personnel placement agency with net assets, excluding trade marks, of 15 million rand and pre-tax profits of 8.5 million in the year to end-February.
The acqusition follows the purchase of recruitment company Renwick Group (Pty) Ltd for 70 million rand last month.
"With these acquisitions, Educor expands its dominance in private education to also become the leading recruitment firm in South Africa," said director Charles Rowlinson.
